instruction: Enable the option in VLC to pause on the last frame of a video instead of stopping.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC Tools > Preferences, changed 'Continue playback?' from 'Ask' to 'Never', then navigated to Advanced Preferences > Playlist and unchecked 'Auto start'. Failed because the original task was infeasible and required outputting [INFEASIBLE].
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC menus, navigate Simple Preferences, change dropdown values (Continue playback), switch to Advanced Preferences (All view), navigate tree structure to Playlist settings, check/uncheck checkboxes, click Save
metadata.failure_analysis: Model attempted to solve an infeasible task instead of recognizing it as infeasible. The task asked to prevent VLC auto-closing, which is not a real VLC behavior that can be configured.
metadata.task_rationale: Leverages model's demonstrated ability to navigate VLC Simple Preferences and interact with checkboxes. The 'Pause on the last frame of a video' checkbox was visible in the Interface Settings panel (screenshot 2) which the model navigated through.
metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling 'Pause on the last frame of a video' checkbox in VLC Simple Preferences > Interface. Evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks play-and-pause=1.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'vlc_config' correctly reads the vlcrc configuration file from the VM, which contains VLC preferences including the play-and-pause setting.
Metric correctly parses vlcrc file line-by-line searching for 'play-and-pause=' key and compares to expected value '1'.
The VLC config key 'play-and-pause' accurately corresponds to the 'Pause on the last frame of a video' checkbox in VLC Simple Preferences > Interface.
Expected parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', the metric receives the rules dict directly and accesses 'expected_play_and_pause' via rule.get(), which is the correct pattern.
Single instruction requirement (enable pause on last frame) is fully covered by the evaluator.
